global_rules: Exact-species evidence is required; genus-level analogy cannot close a gate.
A descriptive floral visit cannot be promoted to effective pollination without transfer or reproductive-effect evidence.
A source may close the binary gate without identifying conflict strength.
Architecture remains a separate extraction and is never inferred from gate closure.
